1KWA1 - The Dark Hunters by Jim Pinto

Four years ago, Captain Talis was demoted and exiled from the city of Florin. His behavior as a soldier had grown more and more deplorable and Talis’ commanders had had enough. Rather than tuck his tail and run, Captain Talis disappeared into the wild and trained a half-dozen or so orcs to fight. For months, they terrorized the countryside, until a group of brave adventurers dispatched Talis and all but two of the orcs — Gog and Magog.

Fleeing from the heroes, the pair found respite in an underground warren where monks had buried sacred dead over 400 years ago. Once inside, the orcs uncovered a partially-opened tomb and upon entering, triggered the wrath of an ancient spirit.

A small town — Quay — had grown over the warren since then, and no one living there knew anything about the burial chambers.

Until now.

The Reaping Stone Deluxe Adventure Battlemaps

Adventure Synopsis Some years ago, Azrenar, a cleric of Maramaga, Scythe-mother and Queen of Rot, petitioned the king of Maerh-Varza to build a great temple to the ancient goddess. In great fury, the king seeks to put the offensive cleric and his followers to the sword and nearly succeeds. His follower's dead bodies line the roads to Maerh-Varza and the cleric Azrenar curses the king, declaring bloody vengeance.

Azrenar hides deep underground and he and his remaining followers find an ancient temple deep within the earth, one formerly held by evil dwarves centuries before Maerh-Varza was built. But when Azrenar takes over the temple, his mind is enraptured by the Reaping Stone, an ancient artifact once held by the Midnight King, a powerful wizard-priest of Maramaga's order.

Now channeling the power of the Reaping Stone, Azrenar has created a deadly supernatural disease, one capable of animating those who die of the horrible wasting disease. Will the spurned cleric turn Maerh-Varza into a zombie-infested metropolis or will the players find the cure in time?

Product Info The Reaping Stone is a deluxe 200 page adventure that will take your characters down a dark path, from 1st level to at least 5th level, as prequel for the upcoming Bleeding Hollow deluxe adventure.

The Reaping Stone is as brutal as the legendary Rappan Athuk and as challenging and engaging as any published Adventure Path, with a good dose of old school carnage binding the lot together.

This adventure has a dark, engaging and compelling story line in which the player characters must race to uncover the cure to a vile supernatural disease. Your players will be highly engaged and invested. They will know fear... especially since they may very well have contracted the supernatural plague themselves!

Written by former 3-time Superstar contestant and Top 4 finalist Tom Phillips (co-author of The Ship of Fools and author of an upcoming Pathfinder Society adventure) with gorgeous cartography masterfully crafted by Superstar finalist Richard Hunt and illustrated by the sensational artist Christopher Stoll, this adventure is an absolute treat for GMs and players alike.

TPK Games always strives to make our products easy on the GM. This adventure has complete stat blocks, placed in the text right where you need them. The entire text is invisibly hyperlinked to the d20pfsrd.com website for ease of reference and extensively hyperlinked. In addition, the encounters all scale so GMs may challenge their players as they see fit.

The Reaping Stone contains several interesting and deadly all-new monsters and dozens of highly memorable encounters that will haunt you and your players for years to come...

Battlemaps The Battlemaps are a 136 page PDF pack of EVERY encounter map, scaled perfectly for gameplay as 1" squares -- just print and play!

Page count: 136 pages of printable battlemaps

A Dark Path Awaits Your Heroes

The Reaping Stone Deluxe Adventure is a gripping Pathfinder Roleplaying Game adventure that takes characters down a dark and dangerous path from 1st level to at least 5th level. This thrilling adventure serves as the perfect prequel to the acclaimed Bleeding Hollow deluxe adventure, setting the stage for even greater challenges to come.

Adventure Overview:

Levels 1-5 - Perfect for starting a new campaign or introducing new characters
Dark Fantasy Theme - Atmospheric storytelling with challenging moral choices
Prequel to Bleeding Hollow - Sets up storylines and NPCs for the next adventure
Complete Adventure Path - Fully developed encounters, NPCs, and plot hooks
Rich Lore - Detailed background and world-building

What's Inside:

This deluxe adventure provides everything a Game Master needs to run an engaging low-level campaign. Your players will face challenging encounters, make difficult decisions, and uncover dark secrets as they progress from inexperienced adventurers to seasoned heroes. The adventure features well-developed NPCs, atmospheric locations, and a compelling narrative that keeps players engaged from start to finish.

Perfect For:

Experienced GMs - Rich content that can be customized and expanded
Dark Fantasy Fans - Atmospheric storytelling with mature themes
Bleeding Hollow Players - Essential backstory and character development
Low-Level Play - Designed specifically for levels 1-5 progression

Adventure Highlights:

Challenging encounters balanced for character progression
Memorable NPCs with detailed motivations and backgrounds
Multiple plot threads that can be expanded by creative GMs
Dark atmosphere perfect for horror-tinged fantasy campaigns
Seamless integration with Bleeding Hollow adventure
Professional layout and organization for easy reference
